comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/drawing-hole-callout.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2054): a 40 x 30 x 20 block (F2.b0) with a counterbored hole through it at (20, 15) (F3: its drill the parameter drill, 6.6 mm; its counterbore 11 mm across, 6.8 deep). Drawing1 (D1, A3) has its top view at 1:1 with the block's box in the middle at (150, 150): the model's (x, y) on the sheet at (130 + x, 135 + y), the hole's centre at (150, 150). All geometry is synthetic.
